drugs.name: Biopan
drugs.uses: Used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), stomach ulcers, and conditions where the stomach produces too much acid.
drugs.mechanism: Works by blocking the hydrogen-potassium ATPase enzyme system (proton pump) in the stomach lining, reducing acid secretion.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, flatulence. Long-term use may affect vitamin B12 and magnesium levels.
drugs.dosage: Usually 40mg once daily, taken before meals.
drugs.precautions: Tell your doctor if you have liver problems. May interact with certain medications like methotrexate.

drugs.name: Dynapan
drugs.uses: Combination drug used for acid reflux, GERD, heartburn, and gastric motility disorders.
drugs.mechanism: Pantoprazole reduces acid, while domperidone blocks dopamine receptors to enhance gastric motility and reduce nausea.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, dry mouth, diarrhea, dizziness. Domperidone may rarely cause heart rhythm issues.
drugs.dosage: Usually one tablet before meals, once or twice daily as directed.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in patients with heart conditions.

drugs.name: Dynapan B
drugs.uses: Used for treating acid reflux, GERD, gastritis, and peptic ulcers.
drugs.mechanism: Dual action - reduces stomach acid production and improves stomach motility.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, dry mouth, abdominal pain, diarrhea.
drugs.dosage: Take as directed by your physician, typically before meals.
drugs.precautions: Not recommended in patients with cardiac conditions.

drugs.name: Paracetamol
drugs.uses: Used for pain relief and fever reduction. Treats headaches, muscle aches, arthritis, backaches, toothaches, colds, and fevers.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits prostaglandin synthesis in the central nervous system and works on heat-regulating centers.
drugs.side_effects: Generally safe at recommended doses. Overdose can cause severe liver damage.
drugs.dosage: Adults: 500-1000mg every 4-6 hours. Maximum 4g per day.
drugs.precautions: Avoid alcohol. Do not exceed maximum daily dose. Use caution in liver disease.

drugs.name: Ibuprofen
drugs.uses: Treats pain, fever, and inflammation. Used for headaches, dental pain, menstrual cramps, muscle aches, arthritis.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits cyclooxygenase enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2), reducing prostaglandin synthesis.
drugs.side_effects: Stomach upset, nausea, dizziness, headache. May cause stomach bleeding with long-term use.
drugs.dosage: 200-400mg every 4-6 hours. Maximum 1200mg/day for OTC use.
drugs.precautions: Take with food. Avoid if you have stomach ulcers or kidney disease.

drugs.name: Aspirin
drugs.uses: Pain relief, fever reduction, anti-inflammatory. Low doses used to prevent heart attacks and strokes.
drugs.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits COX enzymes and prevents platelet aggregation.
drugs.side_effects: Stomach upset, bleeding, tinnitus at high doses.
drugs.dosage: 325-650mg for pain. 75-100mg daily for heart protection.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in children under 16 (Reye's syndrome). Not for those with bleeding disorders.

drugs.name: Metformin
drugs.uses: First-line treatment for type 2 diabetes. Helps control blood sugar levels.
drugs.mechanism: Decreases liver glucose production, decreases intestinal glucose absorption, and improves insulin sensitivity.
drugs.side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, metallic taste. Rare risk of lactic acidosis.
drugs.dosage: Usually starts at 500mg twice daily with meals, may increase gradually.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in kidney disease. Stop before contrast imaging procedures.

drugs.name: Glimepiride
drugs.uses: Used to control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
drugs.mechanism: Stimulates insulin release from pancreatic beta cells.
drugs.precautions: Monitor blood sugar regularly. May cause low blood sugar.

drugs.name: Insulin
drugs.uses: Essential for type 1 diabetes, also used in type 2 diabetes when oral medications are insufficient.
drugs.mechanism: Facilitates glucose uptake by cells, lowers blood sugar levels.
drugs.side_effects: Hypoglycemia, weight gain, injection site reactions.
drugs.dosage: Highly individualized based on blood sugar levels.
drugs.precautions: Monitor blood sugar closely. Store properly. Rotate injection sites.

drugs.name: Amoxicillin
drugs.uses: Treats bacterial infections including ear infections, pneumonia, skin infections, urinary tract infections.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis.
drugs.side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, skin rash. Can cause allergic reactions.
drugs.precautions: Do not use if allergic to penicillins.

drugs.name: Azithromycin
drugs.uses: Treats respiratory infections, skin infections, ear infections, sexually transmitted infections.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding to 50S ribosomal subunit.
drugs.dosage: Usually 500mg on day 1, then 250mg daily for 4 days. Or 500mg daily for 3 days.
drugs.precautions: May prolong QT interval. Use caution in liver disease.

drugs.name: Ciprofloxacin
drugs.uses: Treats urinary tract infections, respiratory infections, bone infections, anthrax.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV.
drugs.side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, dizziness. Risk of tendon rupture.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy. May cause photosensitivity.

drugs.name: Ceftriaxone
drugs.uses: Treats serious bacterial infections: meningitis, pneumonia, sepsis, gonorrhea.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis.
drugs.precautions: Not for use with calcium-containing IV solutions in neonates.

drugs.name: Doxycycline
drugs.uses: Treats acne, respiratory infections, Lyme disease, malaria prevention, chlamydia.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis.
drugs.precautions: Avoid sun exposure. Not for children under 8 or pregnant women.

drugs.name: Omeprazole
drugs.uses: Treats GERD, stomach ulcers, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
drugs.mechanism: Irreversibly blocks hydrogen/potassium ATPase in gastric parietal cells.
drugs.precautions: May interact with clopidogrel. Long-term use requires monitoring.

drugs.name: Ranitidine
drugs.uses: Treats peptic ulcers, GERD, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks histamine H2 receptors, reducing stomach acid secretion.
drugs.precautions: Note: Withdrawn in many countries due to NDMA contamination concerns.

drugs.name: Atorvastatin
drugs.uses: Lowers cholesterol and triglycerides, reduces risk of heart attack and stroke.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase enzyme, reducing cholesterol synthesis in the liver.
drugs.side_effects: Muscle pain, joint pain, diarrhea. Rare risk of rhabdomyolysis.
drugs.dosage: 10-80mg once daily, usually in the evening.
drugs.precautions: Avoid grapefruit. Report unexplained muscle pain.

drugs.name: Rosuvastatin
drugs.uses: Lowers LDL cholesterol and triglycerides, raises HDL cholesterol.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase.
drugs.precautions: Monitor liver function. Avoid in pregnancy.

drugs.name: Amlodipine
drugs.uses: Treats high blood pressure and chest pain (angina).
drugs.mechanism: Blocks calcium channels in blood vessel walls, causing relaxation.
drugs.precautions: Avoid grapefruit.

drugs.name: Losartan
drugs.uses: Treats high blood pressure, protects kidneys in diabetics.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks angiotensin II receptors, causing blood vessel relaxation.
drugs.dosage: 25-100mg daily in one or two doses.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy. Monitor potassium levels.

drugs.name: Lisinopril
drugs.uses: Treats high blood pressure, heart failure, improves survival after heart attack.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits angiotensin-converting enzyme, reducing blood pressure.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy. May cause angioedema.

drugs.name: Enalapril
drugs.uses: Treats hypertension, heart failure, prevents kidney damage in diabetics.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits ACE, lowering blood pressure and reducing heart workload.
drugs.dosage: 5-40mg daily in one or two doses.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy.

drugs.name: Metoprolol
drugs.uses: Treats high blood pressure, angina, heart failure, prevents heart attacks.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks beta-adrenergic receptors, slowing heart rate and reducing blood pressure.
drugs.precautions: Do not stop suddenly. Use caution in asthma.

drugs.name: Atenolol
drugs.uses: Treats hypertension, angina, arrhythmias.
drugs.mechanism: Selective beta-1 adrenergic blocker.
drugs.precautions: Do not stop abruptly.

drugs.name: Hydrochlorothiazide
drugs.uses: Treats high blood pressure and edema.
drugs.mechanism: Increases urine output by inhibiting sodium reabsorption in kidneys.
drugs.precautions: Monitor electrolytes. May increase blood sugar.

drugs.name: Furosemide
drugs.uses: Treats edema from heart failure, liver or kidney disease. Also used for hypertension.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits sodium-potassium-chloride cotransporter in loop of Henle.
drugs.side_effects: Dehydration, low potassium, dizziness, hearing problems.
drugs.precautions: Monitor electrolytes and kidney function.

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.uses: Treats inflammation, allergies, asthma, autoimmune conditions.
drugs.mechanism: Suppresses immune system and reduces inflammation.
drugs.side_effects: Weight gain, mood changes, increased blood sugar, bone loss with long-term use.
drugs.precautions: Do not stop suddenly after long-term use. Increases infection risk.

drugs.name: Prednisolone
drugs.uses: Similar to prednisone - treats inflammation, allergies, autoimmune disorders.
drugs.mechanism: Active form of prednisone, reduces inflammation and immune responses.
drugs.side_effects: Same as prednisone - weight gain, mood changes, increased appetite.
drugs.precautions: Taper dose when discontinuing.

drugs.name: Cetirizine
drugs.uses: Treats allergies, hay fever, hives.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks H1 histamine receptors, reducing allergic symptoms.
drugs.precautions: May cause drowsiness. Avoid alcohol.

drugs.name: Loratadine
drugs.uses: Treats allergic rhinitis, chronic urticaria (hives).
drugs.mechanism: Blocks peripheral H1 receptors without crossing blood-brain barrier.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, dry mouth, fatigue. Less sedating than older antihistamines.
drugs.precautions: Generally well tolerated.

drugs.name: Montelukast
drugs.uses: Prevents asthma attacks, treats allergic rhinitis.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks leukotrienes that cause inflammation and bronchoconstriction.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, stomach pain. Rare neuropsychiatric effects.
drugs.precautions: Not for acute asthma attacks. Watch for mood changes.

drugs.name: Salbutamol
drugs.uses: Relieves acute asthma symptoms and bronchospasm.
drugs.mechanism: Relaxes smooth muscles in airways by stimulating beta-2 receptors.
drugs.precautions: If needing more than 2-3 times per week, see doctor for better control.

drugs.name: Fluticasone
drugs.uses: Prevents asthma attacks, treats allergic rhinitis.
drugs.mechanism: Reduces airway inflammation.
drugs.precautions: Rinse mouth after use. Not for acute attacks.

drugs.name: Levothyroxine
drugs.uses: Treats hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid).
drugs.mechanism: Replaces or supplements the thyroid hormone T4.
drugs.side_effects: Weight loss, tremor, palpitations if dose too high.
drugs.precautions: Take 30-60 minutes before breakfast. Many drug interactions.

drugs.name: Sertraline
drugs.uses: Treats depression, anxiety, panic disorder, OCD, PTSD.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks serotonin reuptake, increasing serotonin levels in brain.
drugs.precautions: May increase suicidal thoughts in young adults. Do not stop suddenly.

drugs.name: Fluoxetine
drugs.uses: Treats depression, OCD, panic disorder, bulimia.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits serotonin reuptake in the brain.
drugs.side_effects: Nausea, nervousness, insomnia, sexual side effects.
drugs.precautions: Long half-life. Many drug interactions.

drugs.name: Escitalopram
drugs.uses: Treats depression and generalized anxiety disorder.
drugs.mechanism: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
drugs.precautions: May prolong QT interval at high doses.

drugs.name: Alprazolam
drugs.uses: Treats anxiety and panic disorders. Short-term use only.
drugs.mechanism: Enhances GABA effects in the brain, producing calming effect.
drugs.side_effects: Drowsiness, dizziness, memory impairment. Risk of dependence.
drugs.precautions: Highly addictive. Do not stop suddenly. Avoid alcohol.

drugs.name: Diazepam
drugs.uses: Treats anxiety, muscle spasms, seizures, alcohol withdrawal.
drugs.mechanism: Enhances GABA activity in CNS.
drugs.side_effects: Drowsiness, fatigue, muscle weakness. Dependence with long-term use.
drugs.precautions: Avoid alcohol. Risk of dependence. Do not stop abruptly.

drugs.name: Clonazepam
drugs.uses: Treats seizures, panic disorder.
drugs.mechanism: Enhances GABA inhibitory effects.
drugs.precautions: May cause dependence. Taper when stopping.

drugs.name: Gabapentin
drugs.uses: Treats nerve pain (neuropathy), seizures, restless leg syndrome.
drugs.mechanism: Binds to voltage-gated calcium channels, reducing nerve hyperactivity.
drugs.precautions: Do not stop suddenly. Dose adjustment needed in kidney disease.

drugs.name: Pregabalin
drugs.uses: Treats nerve pain, fibromyalgia, anxiety, seizures.
drugs.mechanism: Binds to alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels.
drugs.side_effects: Dizziness, drowsiness, weight gain, blurred vision.
drugs.precautions: Controlled substance in some countries. Do not stop suddenly.

drugs.name: Tramadol
drugs.uses: Treats moderate to severe pain.
drugs.mechanism: Weak opioid agonist and inhibits serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake.
drugs.side_effects: Nausea, dizziness, constipation, drowsiness. Risk of dependence.
drugs.precautions: Risk of seizures. Avoid with MAOIs. Dependence risk.

drugs.name: Morphine
drugs.uses: Treats severe pain.
drugs.mechanism: Binds to mu-opioid receptors in the CNS.
drugs.dosage: Highly variable based on pain severity and tolerance.
drugs.precautions: Highly addictive. Monitor for respiratory depression.

drugs.name: Warfarin
drugs.uses: Prevents and treats blood clots, stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits vitamin K-dependent clotting factors.
drugs.dosage: Individualized based on INR monitoring. Usually 2-10mg daily.
drugs.precautions: Many drug and food interactions. Regular INR monitoring required.

drugs.name: Clopidogrel
drugs.uses: Prevents heart attacks and strokes in patients with cardiovascular disease.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits ADP-induced platelet aggregation.
drugs.precautions: May interact with PPIs like omeprazole.

drugs.name: Enoxaparin
drugs.uses: Prevents and treats deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits factor Xa and thrombin.
drugs.dosage: 40mg daily for prevention, 1mg/kg twice daily for treatment.
drugs.precautions: Inject subcutaneously. Monitor platelets.

drugs.name: Vitamin D3
drugs.uses: Treats and prevents vitamin D deficiency, supports bone health.
drugs.mechanism: Essential for calcium absorption and bone metabolism.
drugs.side_effects: Usually none at normal doses. Excess can cause hypercalcemia.
drugs.dosage: 400-2000 IU daily for maintenance. Higher doses for deficiency.
drugs.precautions: Do not exceed recommended doses without medical supervision.

drugs.name: Calcium
drugs.uses: Prevents and treats calcium deficiency, osteoporosis.
drugs.mechanism: Essential mineral for bone health, muscle function, nerve transmission.
drugs.precautions: Take with vitamin D. May interact with some medications.

drugs.name: Iron
drugs.uses: Treats and prevents iron deficiency anemia.
drugs.mechanism: Essential for hemoglobin production.
drugs.side_effects: Constipation, nausea, dark stools, stomach upset.
drugs.dosage: 60-200mg elemental iron daily in divided doses.
drugs.precautions: Take on empty stomach with vitamin C. Avoid with antacids.

drugs.name: Folic Acid
drugs.uses: Prevents and treats folate deficiency, essential during pregnancy to prevent neural tube defects.
drugs.mechanism: Essential for DNA synthesis and cell division.
drugs.side_effects: Generally safe. Rare: nausea, loss of appetite.
drugs.dosage: 400mcg-1mg daily. 4mg for pregnancy with history of neural tube defects.
drugs.precautions: May mask B12 deficiency symptoms.

drugs.name: Vitamin B12
drugs.uses: Treats B12 deficiency, pernicious anemia, neuropathy.
drugs.mechanism: Essential for nerve function and DNA synthesis.
drugs.dosage: 1000mcg orally or injection depending on deficiency.
drugs.precautions: Vegans and elderly at higher risk of deficiency.

drugs.name: Nucoxia
drugs.uses: Treats pain and inflammation in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout.
drugs.mechanism: Selectively inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2).
drugs.precautions: Not for patients with heart disease or uncontrolled hypertension.

drugs.name: Nucoxia-MR
drugs.uses: Used for pain relief with muscle spasm, such as lower back pain, neck pain.
drugs.mechanism: Etoricoxib reduces inflammation while thiocolchicoside relaxes muscles.
drugs.dosage: Usually one tablet once or twice daily.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in pregnancy. Not for long-term use.

drugs.name: Pan 40
drugs.uses: Treats acid-related conditions like GERD, peptic ulcers.
drugs.mechanism: Reduces stomach acid by blocking the proton pump.
drugs.precautions: Use lowest effective dose for shortest duration.

drugs.name: Axomed
drugs.uses: Relieves pain and inflammation in arthritis and musculoskeletal conditions.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits cyclooxygenase enzymes.
drugs.precautions: Avoid in patients with peptic ulcers or kidney disease.

drugs.name: Reflex Plus
drugs.uses: Used for pain relief in conditions like back pain, muscle spasms, joint pain.
drugs.mechanism: Aceclofenac reduces inflammation, paracetamol provides pain relief, chlorzoxazone relaxes muscles.
drugs.dosage: Usually one tablet 2-3 times daily after meals.
drugs.precautions: Avoid alcohol. Not recommended for liver/kidney disease.

drugs.name: Lineoult
drugs.uses: Used to treat irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C).
drugs.mechanism: Activates guanylate cyclase-C receptors, increasing fluid secretion.
drugs.dosage: Usually 145-290 mcg once daily on empty stomach.
drugs.precautions: Contraindicated in children under 6 years.

drugs.name: Fixaraok
drugs.uses: Treats bacterial infections including respiratory, urinary tract, ear infections.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis.
drugs.precautions: Tell your doctor if allergic to penicillins.

drugs.name: Sildenafil
drugs.uses: Treats erectile dysfunction and pulmonary arterial hypertension.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits phosphodiesterase-5, increasing blood flow.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, flushing, nasal congestion, vision changes.
drugs.precautions: Do not use with nitrates. Contraindicated in severe heart disease.

drugs.name: Tadalafil
drugs.uses: Treats erectile dysfunction, BPH, pulmonary arterial hypertension.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits PDE5, improving blood flow.
drugs.side_effects: Headache, indigestion, back pain, muscle aches.
drugs.precautions: Do not use with nitrates.

drugs.name: Ondansetron
drugs.uses: Prevents nausea and vomiting from chemotherapy, radiation, surgery.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks serotonin 5-HT3 receptors in the brain and gut.
drugs.precautions: May prolong QT interval.

drugs.name: Domperidone
drugs.uses: Treats nausea, vomiting, and improves stomach emptying.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks dopamine D2 receptors in the chemoreceptor trigger zone.
drugs.side_effects: Dry mouth, abdominal cramps. May affect heart rhythm.
drugs.precautions: Use lowest dose for shortest time. Cardiac monitoring in some cases.

drugs.name: Metoclopramide
drugs.uses: Treats nausea, vomiting, gastroparesis, GERD.
drugs.mechanism: Blocks dopamine receptors and enhances gastric motility.
drugs.side_effects: Drowsiness, restlessness. Risk of tardive dyskinesia with long use.
drugs.precautions: Limit use to 12 weeks maximum.

drugs.name: Loperamide
drugs.uses: Treats acute and chronic diarrhea.
drugs.mechanism: Slows intestinal motility by acting on opioid receptors in the gut.
drugs.dosage: 4mg initially, then 2mg after each loose stool. Max 16mg/day.
drugs.precautions: Not for bloody diarrhea or fever. Do not exceed recommended dose.

drugs.name: Lactulose
drugs.uses: Treats constipation and hepatic encephalopathy.
drugs.mechanism: Draws water into the colon and promotes bowel movements.
drugs.precautions: May take 24-48 hours to work.

drugs.name: Bisacodyl
drugs.uses: Short-term treatment of constipation, bowel preparation.
drugs.mechanism: Stimulates intestinal contractions.
drugs.precautions: Not for regular use. Do not chew enteric-coated tablets.

drugs.name: Tamsulosin
drugs.uses: Treats benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) symptoms.
drugs.mechanism: Relaxes smooth muscle in prostate and bladder neck.
drugs.precautions: May cause first-dose hypotension. Stand up slowly.

drugs.name: Finasteride
drugs.uses: Treats BPH and male pattern baldness.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT).
drugs.dosage: 5mg daily for BPH, 1mg daily for hair loss.
drugs.precautions: Women who are or may become pregnant should not handle crushed tablets.

drugs.name: Allopurinol
drugs.uses: Prevents gout attacks by lowering uric acid levels.
drugs.mechanism: Inhibits xanthine oxidase, reducing uric acid production.
drugs.precautions: Start at low dose. May trigger gout initially.

drugs.name: Colchicine
drugs.uses: Treats acute gout attacks and prevents recurrence.
drugs.mechanism: Reduces inflammation by inhibiting neutrophil migration.
drugs.dosage: 0.5-1mg initially, then 0.5mg after 1 hour. Max 1.5mg in 1 hour.
drugs.precautions: Narrow therapeutic index. Many drug interactions.
